style_summary: Continues the strong-perspective sports photography, giant white oblique type, near-black field and single-color haze, using a baseball swing, a barbell lift, barrel-wave surfing and a rhythmic-gymnastics ribbon to show four spatial structures: cylinder, heavy plates, wave tube and flexible curve.

environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Runtime source identities and content to replace

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Photographic athletic action uses an extreme near-to-far scale jump: one physically connected piece of equipment or body part dominates the foreground while the athlete recedes into depth.
[CORE] Monumental white heavyweight oblique sans-serif typography cuts through the composition; the athlete occludes selected letter areas without destroying the exact headline.
[CORE] A near-black edge field opens into a luminous single-hue atmospheric band behind the action, producing sharp white-type contrast and dark sculptural human form.
[CORE] Directional photographic motion softness and colored atmospheric streaks carry the force vector while the critical contact point or equipment retains selective detail.

[FLEX] Let each sport determine the spatial structure: a wooden baseball bat foreshortened toward the lens, a near barbell weight plate framing a loaded lift, a surfboard nose inside a curling wave tunnel, or a continuous satin ribbon sweeping near the camera while its gymnast recedes. Continue the established series language with distinct subject, material and force geometry.
[FLEX] Place, rotate, stagger or stretch the type around the movement; protect complete headline comprehension while allowing scale, selected edge cropping, and controlled overlap.
[FLEX] Choose one dominant hue per case, with dark and pale related tones; hues may vary across the family.
[FLEX] Recompose subject, title and negative space independently for portrait and landscape, preserving the same case concept rather than cropping the other ratio.
source_content_to_avoid: The source Nike swoosh, Nike wordmark, JUST DO IT slogan and any recognizable sportswear brand logo.
The PEGASUS42 or PEGASUS 42 model wording and the reference advertising paragraph.
The white running shoe with a teal swoosh as a giant foreground product.
The exact front-facing male runner, lifted knee, grey long-sleeve top and black shorts combination.
The source arrangement of fragmented PEG, S42 and giant brand letters; do not trace its composition.
Part 1 content: track bicycle wheel, chalked climbing hand on rock, freestyle swimming hand, fencing blade, and the headlines BREAK AWAY, HOLD FAST, CUT THROUGH and STRIKE FIRST.
Part 2 content: raised basketball, snowboard underside, kayak paddle, boxing gloves, and the headlines RISE ABOVE, CARVE WILD, DRIVE DEEP and MAKE IMPACT.
Part 3 content: tennis racket grid, wooden gymnastics rings, speed-skating blades, recurve bow and arrow; headlines TURN THE MATCH, DEFY GRAVITY, CHASE THE LINE and STAY TRUE.

visual_deconstruction.reference_observations: The supplied portrait uses a huge near-camera shoe, a receding runner, dark green-to-mint glow, monumental slanted white type and broad foreground speed softness. Small white copy acts as a calm secondary layer. These describe the source; exact product, brand, pose and type positions are not retained.
visual_deconstruction.reusable_system: Oppose an enlarged near contact point with a receding human figure and giant planar lettering; align haze and letter force with the case-specific movement.
visual_deconstruction.continuation_scope: Part 4 preserves the established visual identity from Parts 1 through 3, replacing all sports, equipment and copy with four new cases. Do not trace previous layouts.

composition.hierarchy: Near contact point or equipment first, athlete and movement second, monumental headline sharing the hero scale, small series label and single supporting line last.
composition.depth: Three overlapping planes: atmospheric field, white headline, photographic action, with selected foreground streaks passing in front.
composition.ratio_adaptation: Each case includes separate 9:16 and 16:9 plans. Rebalance scale and negative space rather than center-cropping.

typography.headline: Heavy geometric grotesk, uppercase, oblique or dynamically rotated, white, monumental, exactly spelled and readable as complete words despite selected occlusion.
typography.secondary: Small but clearly readable white sans-serif, slightly oblique optional; restrained case series and one supporting line; no body paragraph.
typography.copy_policy: Render only the three exact case strings, each once; line breaks are flexible but letters and punctuation are not.

color_palette.relationship: Near-black edges 35-50%, one luminous case hue 20-35%, white typography and lit photographic surfaces 20-35%; estimates are compositional guidance.

image_treatment.texture: Clean commercial photographic compositing without paper grain or halftone. Keep focal texture on unprinted wood bat grain, plain rubber weight plates and brushed steel, wet surfboard resin and sculpted water, or a smooth satin ribbon. Directional blur belongs to moving surfaces and the background; the critical contact area stays legible. Chalk and sea spray stay local to grip or wave action. For the held lift use controlled atmospheric depth rather than invented speed streaks.
image_treatment.lighting: Sculptural hard/soft mixed lighting: dark athlete with bright rim and light on the near contact surface; light and haze share the case hue.

design_rules: Keep the foreground object physically connected to a coherent athlete and valid sporting action.
White lettering must function as a large spatial plane interacting with the movement.
Limit finished artwork to the three exact case text strings; do not add logos, pseudocopy or punctuation.
Maintain clean separation between sharp focal evidence and intentional directional softness.
Treat each case concept and each aspect ratio as a designed composition.
do: Check anatomy, contact and equipment continuity at full size.
Keep the headline readable and white type dominant at thumbnail scale.
Preserve atmospheric softness and useful quiet space.
Use sport-specific force geometry to distinguish the four cases.
avoid: Copying the source shoe, swoosh, slogan or runner pose.
Four interchangeable centered figures with only color or props changed.
Random particles, paper grain, fake film damage or decorative HUD graphics.
Overblurring the contact point, malformed hands, floating equipment or illegible headline.
negative_prompt: Nike logo, swoosh, PEGASUS42, JUST DO IT, original running-shoe hero, logo-like symbols, extra text, extra punctuation, watermark, QR code, duplicate limbs, disconnected equipment, fused fingers, fake sharpness, halftone, paper grain, random particles, busy stadium, border, poster mockup, small timid headline, unreadable headline, generic repeated layout, Part 1 sports or headlines, branded ball, printed snowboard underside, jersey number, chest emblem, glove logo, previous eight sports, basketball, snowboard, kayak, boxing gloves, extra racket, missing strings, broken straps, extra rings, duplicated skate runners, duplicated bowstring, disconnected arrow, Part 3 sports or headlines, tennis racket, gymnastics rings, speed skate, recurve bow, disconnected bat, weight plate logos, extra barbell, floating feet, detached surfboard, duplicate ribbon strips, tangled ribbon

values.SUBJECT: An adult male baseball batter in an unmarked charcoal jersey, plain trousers and black protective batting helmet, executing a powerful two-handed swing with one plain wooden baseball bat. His legs are planted in a sparse dark batting area.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: The blunt rounded barrel end of the wooden bat is extremely close to the camera, large in the foreground; the shaft foreshortens continuously back to two hands correctly stacked on the handle. Natural pale wood grain with no lettering or branding. Exactly one bat, no separate ball needed, no disconnected barrel.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The near rounded barrel becomes a compressed cylinder, while the long shaft and twisting torso reveal its actual depth. Use a broad cherry-red arc behind the swing and giant white typography around the bat trajectory. Portrait: barrel end occupies lower-left foreground, athlete recedes upper-right, headline uses upper-left and lower-right open areas in clear reading order. Landscape: near barrel at left-center and connected shaft leads diagonally to batter at right-center, enormous headline across the upper open field. Both hands and their contact with the handle must remain visible.
values.PALETTE: Near-black burgundy, luminous cherry red and bright white; a restrained warm highlight on natural wood and red rim light on the athlete.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female weightlifter in a plain black training singlet and dark shorts, holding a stable overhead squat with one straight barbell, arms extended in a wide snatch grip. Both feet planted on a sparse dark lifting platform, knees aligned and deeply bent, torso controlled.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: A large plain black bumper plate on the near end of the barbell occupies the left foreground, with a clean circular center hole and visible steel collar. The same single straight bar extends back to the two clearly separated gripping hands above the athlete, and a smaller matching plate on its far end. Equal physical plate dimensions despite perspective; no numbers or logos on any plate.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Oppose the huge near circular weight with the small stable athlete beneath the receding bar. The bar must be understood as one load held by both hands overhead. Low camera beside the near plate, sculptural steel and rubber detail, a restrained chalk veil near the hands. Portrait: near plate high-left, bar leads to athlete lower-right with full planted squat visible; huge title descends through the opposite dark area. Landscape: near plate fills left third, straight bar recedes across upper-middle to athlete center-right and far plate near right edge; full squat occupies lower-middle and title uses dark upper zones. Keep anatomy and equipment load path clean.
values.PALETTE: Blue-black charcoal, electric cobalt and silver-white highlights, with a luminous blue atmosphere behind the athlete and a controlled rim on the weight plate.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female surfer in a plain black full wetsuit crouching on one unmarked pale surfboard inside a curling ocean wave, knees bent and both bare feet visibly planted on the board deck. One arm reaches forward for balance and the other trails naturally.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: The broad pointed nose of the surfboard rushes close to the lower foreground, with wet pale resin and a dark rail. Its deck runs continuously back to the two planted feet and surfer. A jade wave curls overhead, forming a tunnel of water with a luminous opening behind the rider. No snow, no paddle, no detached board.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Make the wave a three-dimensional enclosing arc, a much larger spatial structure than the athlete and board. The board nose supplies near-camera scale while white megatype follows the open dark pockets within and around the barrel, avoiding a rectangular text panel. Portrait: near board nose low-left, rider recedes middle-right, curved crest arches from upper-left over the top; headline uses the upper interior and lower-right pockets with clear word order. Landscape: board nose dominates lower-left and rider is right-center, the curling lip forms a wide ceiling; title spans the upper-left dark part of the wave. Preserve a believable wave face and rail contact.
values.PALETTE: Near-black deep jade, luminous emerald sea glass and pale seafoam-white, with light transmitted through the wave lip and selective white spray.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female rhythmic gymnast in a plain black long-sleeve leotard, executing an elegant split leap in a sparse dark arena. One hand holds a short unmarked ribbon stick, the other arm counterbalances. One continuous warm-apricot satin ribbon is visibly attached to the tip of that stick.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: A section of the same satin ribbon sweeps very close to the lens as a broad softly curving foreground strip, then narrows continuously in depth toward the stick in the gymnast hand. Show a coherent single ribbon path with no loose duplicate strips; it can form two open loops, never a knot. The gymnast has two natural arms and two extended legs in an anatomically coherent airborne split.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Use a flexible calligraphic ribbon curve as the foreground hero, with the sharply defined airborne gymnast receding through its open loop. The ribbon is a physical satin strip, not a light trail, drawn doodle or typographic character. Huge white oblique text interacts with its open negative spaces. Portrait: near ribbon curls across lower-left and up the side, gymnast flies across the middle, title split between upper and lower quiet zones. Landscape: one broad ribbon curve enters from lower-left and sweeps toward upper-right, gymnast is near center-right, title stretches across the open upper-left and lower-right space. Keep the hand-to-stick-to-ribbon connection readable.
values.PALETTE: Near-black warm brown, luminous apricot-orange satin and bright warm white, with a soft peach glow behind the athlete and a narrow warm edge light on the ribbon.
